conbody.note: No hands. Do not place hands in this area. Do not touch, lean on, or reach through the mast or permit others to do so.

p.b: No Standing On Forks Warning, No Standing Under Forks Warning

conbody.note: Do not stand or ride on the forks. Do not stand or ride on a load or pallet on the forks. Do not stand or walk under the forks.

p.b: Load Backrest Must Be In Place Warning

conbody.note: Operation without this device in place may be hazardous.

p.b: Overhead Guard Must Be In Place Warning

conbody.note: Operation without this device in place may be hazardous. This guard conforms to A.N.S.I.B56.1 and F.E.M.Section IV.
conbody.p: This design has been tested with an impact of appropriate value.
